home.heading: Welcome to the Employment Insurance Portal
home.intro: Submit and track your Employment Insurance claim securely.

submitClaim.heading: Submit an Employment Insurance claim
submitClaim.intro: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.

sin.label: Social Insurance Number (SIN)
sin.hint: Enter your 9-digit SIN. Spaces and dashes are allowed.

employerBn.label: Employer Business Number (BN)
employerBn.hint: Enter the 9-digit BN, or the 15-character BN with program account (for example 123456789RT0001).

insurableHours.label: Insurable hours
insurableHours.hint: Total insurable hours worked in your qualifying period.

insurableEarnings.label: Insurable earnings
insurableEarnings.hint: Total insurable earnings in Canadian dollars.

separationDate.label: Separation date
separationDate.hint: The last day you worked, in year-month-day format. It cannot be in the future.

separationReason.label: Reason for separation
separationReason.hint: Briefly describe why your employment ended.

roeDocument.label: Record of Employment (ROE) document
roeDocument.hint: Optional. Attach your ROE as a PDF, XML, or JSON file.

errors.generic: This field is invalid. Please review your entry.
errors.network: We could not reach the service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Your claim could not be submitted right now. Please try again later.

sin.INVALID: Enter a valid 9-digit SIN. It must pass the check-digit test and cannot start with 0.

employerBn.INVALID: Enter a valid BN: 9 digits, or 9 digits plus a program code and 4-digit account.

insurableHours.MISSING: Enter the total insurable hours worked.
insurableHours.INVALID: Insurable hours must be a number greater than 0.
insurableHours.TOO_LARGE: Insurable hours cannot exceed 3120 (60 hours per week over 52 weeks).

insurableEarnings.INVALID: Insurable earnings must be a number greater than 0.

separationDate.INVALID: Enter a valid date in year-month-day format that is not in the future.

separationReason.TOO_LARGE: The reason for separation must be 1000 characters or fewer.

confirmation.heading: Claim submitted successfully
confirmation.body: Your claim has been received and is being processed. Keep your Claim ID for your records.
